info.title: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole
info.synopsis: Un giorno, i due studenti universitari Maki e Yaeko mentre passeggiano notano uno strano individuo venire colpito da un dizionario giapponese caduto dal cielo. L'uomo, dall'aspetto bizzarro, rifiuta i soccorsi nonostante stia sanguinando. Da quel momento i due giovani iniziano a vedere cose bizzarre.

episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: 事件後、一連の責任を鮫島家に押し付けようとする島民たちを叱りつけたのは、八重子の父だった。騒動が解決し帰ろうとするモグラに、八重子の曽祖父・雄八は１通の手紙を託す。それはかつての戦友へのメッセージだった。東京へと戻ってきた後、抽斗通りで駄菓子屋の女性と出会った真木は、彼女の名と役職、そして、モグラの驚くべき過去を知る…。

info.title: Bubblegum Crisis (ITA)
info.synopsis: Anno 2025, un terremoto ha distrutto Tokyo. Con l'ausilio dei Boomers, androidi creati dalla Genom corporation, la città è stata ricostruita. Anno 2032, Megatokyo. In questa metropoli computerizzata i Boomers sono ormai diventati simili agli esseri umani. Purtroppo, a causa di alcuni esperimenti condotti dalla Genom per sfruttarli come mezzi bellici, alcuni Boomers hanno la tendenza a perdere il controllo, mettendo a rischio la popolazione senza che la polizia possa contrastare la loro superiore potenza. Sylia Stingray, la figlia miliardaria dello scienziato che inventò i Boomers, ha proseguito le ricerche del padre sulle armature meccanizzate Hard Suit e ha reclutato tre ragazze che, assieme a lei, formano il gruppo di mercenarie Knight Sabers: la cantante rock Priscilla Asagiri; l'insegnante di aerobica Linna Yamazaki; la poliziotta esperta di computer Nene Romanova. Queste quattro ragazze, con il supporto del fratello di Sylia, combattono ogni notte per arginare il crescente problema dei Boomers ed ostacolare i piani criminali della Genom.

related.title: A.D. Police: To Protect and Serve

variants.title: A.D. Police: To Protect and Serve

episodes.title: Tinsel City
episodes.synopsis: And so it begins, with the appearance of the Boomers, and the plan by GENOM to try and control the world. But can the Knight Sabers stop them from kidnapping a computer technician, and what's Mason, head guy at GENOM, planning? This is the beginning of a three-episode arc, ending with episode 3.

episodes.title: Born To Kill
episodes.synopsis: Part 2: Cynthia, the newly formed Boomer, has recently been destroyed, but now an even bigger threat awaits the Sabers. When GENOM reveals their new threat, a super strong Boomer created from the remains of Cynthia. The Sabers may have destroyed it, but is that all that awaits them?

episodes.title: Blow Up
episodes.synopsis: Part 3:  GENOM's Boomers are terrorizing MegaTokyo and the AD Police is helpless, or rather useless, to stop them. But GENOM may have gone too far this time, by terrorizing Sho, the boy Priss looks after. Can Priss finally stop Mason while keeping her cool, and her moral code as a Knight Saber, with it?

episodes.title: Revenge Road
episodes.synopsis: A year later and there's not been much action from GENOM for the Knight Sabers. But now there's a strange new car called the Griffon that's terrorizing bike gangs in the city. When the Knight Sabers arrive at the scene, they realize the Griffon's not all at fault, and it's going to take a lot of firepower to stop it from wiping all bike gangs, and its creators, out of existence.

episodes.title: Moonlight Rambler
episodes.synopsis: There's a lot of trouble brewing over MegaTokyo, as the space island Genaro is recoiling over the loss of their shuttle and weapons, and the exposure of their ties with GENOM. Meanwhile, a "vampire" has recently been sucking people's blood everywhere, and Priss's mysterious new friend Sylvie has some interesting ties with the island controversy.

episodes.title: Red Eyes
episodes.synopsis: The 33-S Boomers are back to seek revenge on the Knight Sabers. How do they do it? By framing the Knight Sabers, that's how!

episodes.title: Double Vision
episodes.synopsis: GENOM's back with a new creation, a new breed of Boomer that will prove to be a challenge for the Knight Sabers. Also, an American Rock star known simply as "Vision" has come to MegaTokyo to spread the word of rock to its citizens... that is, until she gets mixed up with the likes of GENOM.

episodes.title: Scoop Chase
episodes.synopsis: The Knight Sabers seem to have all under control, until "ace reporter" Lisa Vanette threatens to reveal the true identities of the girls. Plus, GENOM's got some brand new, specially created Boomers, with weapons aimed directly at the Sabers.

info.title: Phantom Thief Reinya
info.synopsis: Reinya sembra una ragazza qualunque che lavora in un minimarket, ma in realtà è la ladra fantasma Reinya. Insieme al suo assistente Chuutarou, nel loro nascondiglio segreto situato proprio sotto il minimarket locale, Reinya elabora piani per rubare vari tesori d’oro. A contrastarli c’è un trio incompetente formato da un ispettore di polizia pervertito, una poliziotta naturalmente svampita e un detective totalmente infatuato di Reinya, tutti di stanza in una centrale di polizia accanto al minimarket di Reinya.

episodes.title: No way! Someone's got it in for me!
Oh, no . . . Reinya is finally beaten!

info.title: Girl from Phantasia
info.synopsis: Akihiro è un ragazzo che ama fantasticare. Mentre sta per uscire con la sua fidanzata Miyuki trova in casa uno strano tappeto, dal quale esce magicamente una ragazza molto carina di nome Malon, che racconta di provenire dal mondo di Phantasia, dal quale è scappata per sfuggire alle mire del malvagio mago Roll. Inizia per Akihiro una difficile quanto rocambolesca convivenza con la nuova amica.

info.title: Dragonite and the Special Delivery (ITA)
info.synopsis: Animazione speciale realizzata per commemorare il Pokémon Day 2025. Questo cortometraggio segue la storia di Hana, una giovane ragazza che vive a Paldea e ammira il Dragonite postino. Hana sogna di diventare una postina, ma un giorno trova una lettera senza destinatario e decide di provare ad aiutare a trovare il mittente insieme al suo compagno Fuecoco. Quando riescono a rintracciare il mittente, un ragazzo di nome Rio, scoprono che Rio aveva scritto la lettera per festeggiare il compleanno di suo padre che vive a Kanto. Per di più, il compleanno è proprio oggi. Ora spetta a Hana, Rio e Dragonite consegnare la lettera il più rapidamente possibile.

episodes.title: Break Up
episodes.synopsis: The war with Tenjiku reaches a deadly conclusion. Takemichi takes this chance to tell Mikey he is a Time Leaper, and explains everything he has been through. After hearing the truth, Mikey announces that the Tokyo Manji Gang is disbanding. The legendary organization that once stood at the top of Japan has come to an end.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.synopsis: Following Tokyo Manji Gang's disbandment, Takemichi is about to return to his original timeline, but a forgotten Valentine's gift for Hina leads to an unexpected proposal. After burying a time capsule with his comrades and promising to meet again in 12 years, Takemichi makes a Time Leap. He arrives in a world where all his friends are living happily, but Mikey is nowhere to be found.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.synopsis: Twelve years later, the criminal underworld is ruled by Bonten, an organization far more vicious than the old Tokyo Manji Gang. Takemichi is stunned to learn that Bonten is led by someone from his former life. He wants to go back in time, but the power he once relied on is now out of reach. With no way back, Takemichi meets his friends to open the time capsule they buried 12 years ago.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.synopsis: Takemichi plays the videotape Mikey slipped into the time capsule, which includes a message meant just for him. Mikey from twelve years ago reveals a darkness inside him that Shinichiro, Emma, and Baji had kept at bay. Having lost everyone who could stop him, Mikey has cut ties with Tokyo Manji Gang, distancing himself from his friends. After learning of Mikey's anguish, Takemichi ignores the danger and tries to make contact.
